Disabling it causes later [mapping access](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/blob/v01-38/DDG4/src/Geant4Mapping.cpp) to throw. - `/private/tmp/nodd-pr118-nodd/DD4hep-v01-38-Geant4VolumeManager.cpp`, `Populator::add_entry`, scans assembly-imprint vectors for matching paths. This is consistent with the supplied profiles’ `scanPhysicalVolume`/`memcmp` hotspot. An indexed lookup would require a separately scoped implementation and equivalence validation.
- Main subsequently observed unchanged jobs clearing mapping, completing the first 200 showers, and encountering recurring `CreateCoupleTables→ScanAndSetCouple` overhead at another `beamOn`. I have not established a safe configuration bypass for that second overhead.
